content_units: Informational only: this is a practical meal-planning guide, not a diagnosis or personalized medical treatment plan. It is built around about   1,800 calories/day  ,   moderate carbs  ,   high fiber  ,   lower sodium  ,   budget-conscious choices  ,   minimal cooking time  , and foods that may support steadier blood sugar and weight loss.

1     Greek yogurt oat bowl  : plain Greek yogurt, 1/3 cup oats, berries, chia seeds, cinnamon.     Turkey hummus wrap  : whole-wheat tortilla, sliced turkey, hummus, spinach, cucumber; side apple.     Sheet-pan chicken & vegetables  : roasted chicken breast, broccoli, carrots, brown rice.   Small handful of unsalted almonds.

2     Veggie eggs & toast  : 2 eggs scrambled with spinach and mushrooms, 1 slice whole-grain toast, small orange.     Tuna bean salad  : no-salt-added tuna, white beans, lettuce, tomato, olive oil, lemon.     Turkey chili  : lean ground turkey, black beans, diced tomatoes, onion, bell pepper.   Carrot sticks with hummus.

3     Overnight oats  : oats, milk, chia, peanut butter, sliced banana.     Chicken quinoa bowl  : cooked chicken, quinoa, cucumber, tomato, spinach, olive oil vinaigrette.     Salmon, sweet potato, green beans  : baked salmon, roasted sweet potato, steamed green beans.   Cottage cheese with berries.

4     Cottage cheese breakfast plate  : cottage cheese, pear slices, walnuts, cinnamon.     Lentil soup + toast  : low-sodium lentil soup, side salad, 1 slice whole-grain toast.     Beef and vegetable stir-fry  : lean beef strips, frozen mixed vegetables, brown rice.   Apple with 1 tbsp peanut butter.

5     Oatmeal with nuts  : oats cooked with milk, topped with blueberries and chopped walnuts.     Egg salad pita  : chopped boiled eggs with Greek yogurt and mustard in whole-wheat pita, lettuce, tomato.     Chicken taco bowl  : chicken, brown rice, black beans, salsa, avocado, shredded lettuce.   Plain Greek yogurt with cinnamon.

6     Protein smoothie  : Greek yogurt, spinach, frozen berries, peanut butter, milk.     Leftover turkey chili   with side cucumber salad.     Baked cod or extra chicken   with quinoa and roasted Brussels sprouts/carrots.   Unsalted popcorn or almonds.

7     Avocado egg toast  : 1 slice whole-grain toast, 2 eggs, avocado, tomato.     Chickpea salad bowl  : chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, spinach, olive oil, lemon; side fruit.     Slow-pan turkey meatballs   with marinara, whole-wheat pasta, side broccoli.   Cottage cheese or yogurt with sliced apple.
- Each day is designed to land near   1,700-1,900 calories  , depending on portion size.
- Carbs are spread across meals to help avoid large blood sugar swings.
- Sodium stays lower by using   no-salt-added canned items  , plain frozen vegetables, herbs, lemon, vinegar, garlic, and modest packaged sauces.
- Most meals can be made in   10-30 minutes  , and several intentionally reuse ingredients to save time and cost.
- Estimated total grocery cost with store-brand items is roughly   $80-$90   in many U.S. supermarkets.
- Spinach or mixed greens, 2 large tubs/bags
- Green beans, 1 bag fresh or frozen
- Brussels sprouts or extra carrots, 1 bag
- Chicken breast or thighs, about 3 lb
- Cod fillets or extra chicken, about 1 lb
- Lean deli turkey, 1 pack low-sodium if available
- Plain popcorn kernels or low-sodium popcorn
Meal Timing and Portion Control Tips
- Aim for meals about every   4-5 hours   with one planned snack if needed.
- A steady routine often helps with appetite and blood sugar control.
-   1/4 plate   whole grains or starchy vegetables
- A simple target per meal is about   30-45 grams of carbohydrate  , adjusted by appetite and usual glucose response.
- Avoid having most of the day’s carbs at dinner.
4.   Pair carbs with protein or fiber
- Fruit alone may raise blood sugar faster than fruit with nuts, yogurt, cottage cheese, or peanut butter.
- Good pairings: apple + peanut butter, berries + yogurt, carrots + hummus.
- Nuts, rice, pasta, and avocado are healthy but easy to overeat.
- Batch-cook   brown rice or quinoa  ,   chicken  , and   turkey chili   once to cover multiple meals.
- Choose   frozen vegetables and berries   to cut prep time and cost.
- For knee osteoarthritis comfort, simpler prep can reduce standing time: sheet-pan meals, slow simmer chili, microwave-steam vegetables, and pre-cut produce all help.
- If he monitors blood sugar at home, meals with the best day-to-day fit are usually the ones that keep readings more predictable and hunger manageable.
